name: Sorry About The Mess
overview:
SORRY ABOUT THE MESS is a punk rock adult animated comedy fantasy series written by and starring award-winning Australian trans comedian Cassie Workman, with executive producer Lilly Wachowski. The series is produced by Princess Pictures.

SORRY ABOUT THE MESS follows trans trainwreck Alice Peril, a punk rock singer in Olympia, Washington, navigating a world-ending supernatural threat along with a badly timed break up, using more wit than the situation probably deserves…
